map.铸造方法选型（查表过滤，非公式）：按「材料在方法适配清单、壁厚不低于方法最小壁厚: Casting method selection (table filtering, not a formula): filter the five METHODS by "material in the method suitability list, wall thickness not below the method minimum, weight not above the method maximum, batch mutual exclusion (high/medium-volume methods exclude one-off small batches)" — sand casting (≥3 mm, ≤100000 kg), permanent mold (≥2.5, ≤100 kg), investment casting (≥0.5, ≤50 kg), die casting (≥0.5, ≤30 kg), low pressure (≥2, ≤200 kg). Validation: non-positive weight or wall thickness reports "Please enter a valid casting weight/wall thickness". Criterion: no match reports "No ideal casting method currently"; otherwise the first is the preferred method and the rest are listed as "Other options".
